items.asset_inspection: PNG, 1528x1749, 8-bit RGBA (colorType 6), non-interlaced, 614192 bytes. Artwork: the same teardrop silhouette as 'mascot (3).png' but desaturated to a grey/silver gradient body (dark on the upper-left flank, light along the lower-right), keeping the two white oval eyes and the wide white blurred halo on transparency.

PNG, 743x339, 8-bit RGBA, non-interlaced, 180035 bytes. Chunks IHDR,pHYs,sRGB,gAMA,tEXt,IDAT,IEND; pHYs 2835x2835 px/metre (=72 dpi), sRGB intent 0, gAMA 45455, tEXt Software=Figma. Artwork: a single soft horizontally-stretched elliptical blur in neutral grey/black, densest in a flat-ended band across the middle and fading to full transparency at the edges. No hard geometry and no colour cast.

PNG, 743x339, 8-bit RGBA, non-interlaced, 279706 bytes. Chunks IHDR,pHYs,sRGB,gAMA,tEXt,IDAT,IEND; pHYs 2835x2835 unit=1, sRGB intent 0, gAMA 45455, tEXt Software=Figma. Artwork: the same soft stretched ellipse as 'shadow dark.png' but tinted slate/steel blue, with a desaturated navy core fading out through pale blue-grey to transparency, matching the blue icon plate.

Artwork: a red app-tile squircle with a dark outline and a top notch, a glossy red gradient face, and a cream/off-white open-ended wrench lying on a diagonal with a small check mark cut into its head.

PNG, 128x128, 8-bit RGBA, non-interlaced, 20285 bytes. Chunks IHDR,sRGB,eXIf,IDAT,IEND. Artwork: a blue app-tile squircle with a dark outline and a top notch, a blue vertical gradient face, bearing a thick white plus sign with a small white four-pointed sparkle at its upper right.

PNG, 128x128, 8-bit RGBA, non-interlaced, 17578 bytes. Chunks IHDR,sRGB,eXIf,IDAT,IEND. Artwork: a purple app-tile squircle with a dark outline and a top notch, carrying three stacked horizontal slider rails in pale lilac, each with one round knob at a different position along its rail.

PNG, 256x256, 8-bit RGBA, non-interlaced, 51677 bytes. Chunks IHDR,gAMA,cHRM,eXIf,pHYs,iTXt,IDAT,IEND; gAMA 45455, pHYs 5669x5669 unit=1, iTXt XML:com.adobe.xmp written by XMP Core 6.0.0. Artwork: the Droppy company mark, a rounded-square (squircle) tile filled with a light-to-mid blue vertical gradient carrying the glossy translucent teardrop mascot with two white oval eyes. Plain blue plate, no binary-digit pattern.

PNG, 512x512, 8-bit RGBA, non-interlaced, 168848 bytes. Chunks IHDR,gAMA,cHRM,eXIf,pHYs,iTXt,IDAT,IEND; gAMA 45455, pHYs 5669x5669 unit=1, iTXt XML:com.adobe.xmp. Artwork: the same plain-blue squircle Droppy mark at double resolution; the teardrop's glassy rim highlight and the two white eyes are visibly crisper, and the plate's gradient runs pale blue at the top to a stronger blue at the bottom.

PNG, 1320x824, 8-bit RGB (colorType 2, no alpha), non-interlaced, 546393 bytes; chunks IHDR,iCCP,IDAT,IEND with an embedded profile named 'ICC Profile'. Content: a screenshot of the Droppy Code window titled 'Welcome tour for the app' showing the lead reply 'Three heads are out: one builds the tour window, one writes the pages and wires the Help menu, one photographs every page. I keep the design and the integration.', a 'Sending out 3 heads' card listing 'Tour window and slideshow', 'Tour pages and Help menu', 'Screenshots for every page', three 'Sent out Hank/Walter/Ada' rows, status pills 'Hank is done', 'Walter and Ada are working' and 'Hank finished working', and a head panel docked on the right headed 'Ada' with 'working 58s' and the placeholder 'Ask OpenCode to build, fix or explai'.

PNG, 1320x824, 8-bit RGB, non-interlaced, 404967 bytes; chunks IHDR,iCCP,IDAT,IEND with an embedded ICC profile. Content: a screenshot of the empty-chat window (title 'Attachment strip insets', greeting 'What should we build in Droppy Code?' over the dark mascot tile) with the model picker popover open on the right. The popover is headed 'Select model' with a back chevron; its 'Pairs' section lists 'Fable + Gemini 3.8 Flash / Claude lead, Antigravity heads' and 'Fable + OpenRouter/Mus... / Claude lead, OpenCode heads'; the 'Models' section lists Opus (Claude, with a lightning bolt and a check mark), Sonnet (Claude), Gemini 3.8 Flash (Antigravity), V4 Pro (DeepSeek) and Spark 1.3 (Meta).

PNG, 1320x824, 8-bit RGB, non-interlaced, 538872 bytes; chunks IHDR,iCCP,IDAT,IEND with an embedded ICC profile. Content: the 'Welcome tour for the app' window with two head panels docked along the bottom edge. Bottom-left is 'Hank  done 48s' captioned 'Tour window and slideshow'; bottom-right is a '2' heads chip with 'Ada  working 1m 23s' captioned 'Screenshots for every page'; both carry their own 'Ask OpenCode to build, fix or explai' composers. The centre conversation keeps a 2-of-3 checklist ('Crop every capture on its action', 'Swap the site's films for stills', 'Upload the set and deploy'), an 'Edited +51 -37' row, and its own 'Ask Claude for anything; bi' composer with a 'Fable High' chip.

PNG, 1320x824, 8-bit RGB, non-interlaced, 682913 bytes; chunks IHDR,iCCP,IDAT,IEND with an embedded ICC profile. Content: the app window floating over an iridescent wallpaper with the Cookbook panel open on the right. Panel header 'Cookbook' with the subtitle 'Pairs built from the models in your library: which one leads, at what effort, and which ones build. Add one and it is in the model picker.' Rows, each with a blue '+ Add' button: 'Fable + Opus', 'Opus + Gemini 3.8 Flash' (Claude lead, Antigravity heads - Lead high, heads medium effort), 'Opus + V4.1 Flash' (Claude lead, DeepSeek heads - High effort), '6 Astra + Spark 1.3 Contributor' (Command Code lead, Meta heads - Lead high, heads medium effort) and '6 Astra + 5.6 Terra' (Command Code lead, Codex heads - Lead high, heads medium effort).

PNG, 1320x824, 8-bit RGB, non-interlaced, 342603 bytes; chunks IHDR,iCCP,IDAT,IEND with an embedded ICC profile. Content: a tight crop on the effort popover. The card shows the title 'Max' with a disclosure chevron, the word painted in a pink-to-blue gradient, a reset arrow at the top right, the subtitle 'Fable + Gemini 3.8 Flash' with a small lead glyph, a wide rounded track running burnt orange on the left through a white hot spot into blue on the right with speckled particles and a large pale-pink knob at the far right, and the caption "The lead's effort \u00b7 heads keep their own". Below it the composer strip shows 'Fable Max' with a chevron.

PNG, 1320x824, 8-bit RGB, non-interlaced, 733624 bytes. Chunks are IHDR,IDAT,IEND only, with NO iCCP profile, unlike every other tour still, because it is composited by Pillow rather than exported through the screen-capture path. Content: a 2x2 mosaic of the same 'Composer: draft photo spacing' conversation rendered in four themes with a thin dark seam between tiles: top-left a blue-violet dark theme, top-right a warm brown/amber dark theme, bottom-left a pale lavender light theme, bottom-right a muted rose/plum dark theme.

PNG, 1320x824, 8-bit RGB, non-interlaced, 746435 bytes; chunks IHDR,iCCP,IDAT,IEND with an embedded ICC profile. Content: the sidebar-less window over a glassy wallpaper with the Threads floating panel open at the top left. The panel has a 'Search threads' field and a bell button, a 'Today' group listing 'Welcome tour for the app / Droppy Code' with a nested '3 heads' disclosure, 'Composer: draft photo spacing / Droppy Code' highlighted, 'Regional pricing claim expiry / getdroppy.app', 'Attachment strip insets', 'Timeline final answer', 'Final answer card' and 'Archive: delete all', a 'Yesterday' group cut off below, and a footer with '+ Add project' and a gear 'Settings' row.

PNG, 1320x824, 8-bit RGB, non-interlaced, 485967 bytes; chunks IHDR,iCCP,IDAT,IEND with an embedded ICC profile. Content: an edge-to-edge shot of the window titled 'Composer: draft photo spacing' with traffic lights, toolbar buttons and a 'main' branch chip at the top. The thread shows the user bubble 'Where does the composer decide how far the draft photo sits from the edges?', a 'Worked for 58s' disclosure, an answer naming DraftAttachments inside ComposerView.swift and attachmentInset (14pt), the follow-up 'Want me to give the top the same 14pt?', a second user bubble, an 'Edited files, read files' row, a '2 of 3 done' checklist, a 'Running xcodebuild -scheme DroppyCode build' line, a '1 file +3 -1' diff pill, and the composer with placeholder 'Ask Claude for anything; big jobs go out to a team of heads' and an 'Opus High' chip.

bundle.mjs printed 'binary' in its line column for this path, but the file is plain ASCII text with CRLF line terminators, 37,215 bytes, 684 lines (verified with `file` and `wc -l`), so it was read end to end as text rather than inspected as an asset. No binary content is present.

PNG, 256x256, 8-bit RGBA, non-interlaced, 51677 bytes. Chunks IHDR,gAMA,cHRM,eXIf,pHYs,iTXt,IDAT,IEND; gAMA 45455, pHYs 5669x5669 unit=1, iTXt XML:com.adobe.xmp from XMP Core 6.0.0. Its sha256 is identical to DroppyCode/Resources/Assets.xcassets/droppy-logo.imageset/droppy-logo.png, so it is a byte-for-byte duplicate of the in-app 1x logo. Artwork: the plain blue squircle Droppy company mark with the glassy teardrop and two white eyes, no binary backdrop.

PNG, 512x512, 8-bit RGBA, non-interlaced, 168110 bytes. Chunks IHDR,gAMA,cHRM,eXIf,pHYs,iTXt,IDAT,IEND; gAMA 45455, pHYs 5669x5669 unit=1, iTXt XML:com.adobe.xmp. Artwork: the Droppy CODE app icon rather than the plain Droppy logo. A blue squircle whose plate is filled with rows of faint white binary digits (0s and 1s), a soft drop shadow beneath the tile, and the glossy translucent teardrop mascot with two white oval eyes centred on top.
